name: flutter
why: Largest widely-used Dart codebase. Heavy framework boilerplate makes it the sharpest available precision test, and its size is what exposes resource behaviour.

ceilings.rationale: 3072 MB is the hard ceiling for this corpus; the working budget is 1 GiB ([PERF-FLUTTER-TODO-DONE]). Ceilings are sized per repository: the limit is a function of the corpus's own size, never of the CI runner that happens to host the test. The wall ceiling is the product requirement: a cold scan of this corpus must finish inside 10 minutes [PERF-FLUTTER-TODO-GATE].

must_not_rank_first.why: Flutter mandates that every StatefulWidget declare its own createState(), and every StatelessWidget its own build(). These shapes cannot be extracted or merged, so they must never outrank genuine copy-paste. Tracked by issue #331. Each entry is a base-type name, matched against the AST heritage clause of the declaration the ranked occurrence belongs to - never against source text, which fired on comments and missed wrapped clauses (issue #401).
